mapper.select: SELECT CATEGORY_CODE as categoryCode, CATEGORY_NAME as categoryName, CATEGORY_VALUE as categoryValue, PARENT_CODE as parentCode, SORT as sort, USE_YN as useYn FROM SYSTEM.TB_CATEGORY WHERE USE_YN = 'Y'

SELECT PRODUCT_CODE, PRODUCT_NAME, CATEGORY_CODE, PRODUCT_PRIEC, USE_YN FROM SYSTEM.TB_PRODUCT WHERE USE_YN = 'Y' and category_code = #{search.categoryCode} OFFSET #{search.startPage} ROWS FETCH FIRST #{search.pageSize} ROWS ONLY
